correctness.rationale: The exact symbolic residual is (ap^2-cp+b)(z-p)/z, which vanishes under the uniquely solvable equilibrium equation. For fixed a<=0,b,c>0, the entropic function is nonnegative and proper on z>0; a forward trajectory stays on a compact sublevel, yielding global existence. The integrating factor shows immediate height positivity for initial z>=0. At a<0 the zero-derivative locus is y=-p,z=p, whose only invariant point is E; at a=0 it is z=p, and invariance enforces x=0,y=-p. LaSalle proves convergence including the equality case. Integration gives exact total dissipation; the maximal-value backward orbit and stationary-measure arguments establish the compact recurrence corollaries. These are analytic deductions, not finite experiments.

Indexed closest compact-recurrence and height-conditional measure results specify positive parameters; comparing implication and parameter domains rather than titles, none entails the theorem. value.rationale: Nonpositive a is the intrinsic feedback-damping sign boundary in the oscillator component of a classical chaotic three-dimensional flow. The exact proper logarithmic entropy cancels nonlinear coupling and yields a global full-basin convergence theorem across all positive b,c, including the undamped boundary a=0. The result is more than a local stability calculation or numerical parameter sample: it proves forward completeness, excludes compact recurrent nontrivial dynamics, and evaluates total dissipation exactly. The half-space is naturally invariant because b>0 drives trajectories inward at z=0.
